# Upstream provenance

Source: https://github.com/MX3a48c5/dsh-fish-tone
Revision: b22b071644379ae8abb2640c412eef9ea2de49ee
Main package: 0.3.0; flavor package: 0.1.1. License: MIT (see LICENSE).

Only text algorithms and static meme data are included. The DSH host plugin, global system prompt, HTTP management routes and package-local configuration are excluded.

Local adaptations: full random candidate pool; fenced-code protection in flavor modes; the bridge adapter dispatches shock directly and returns the input unchanged for strength=off. Automatic typo injection and semantic micro-mark insertion are disabled in the bridge. Tool calls use the existing content-service permissions.
